summary.intent: Improve Cohezion's ability to model agents as Exotic Vacuum Objects (EVOs) by capturing agentic journeys through the Quadrature Nexus and FLUME VAE into SurrealDB, then feeding synthesized patterns from Ouroboros and Mycelium back into QuadratureNexus alignment scores as a closed loop — running continuously overnight.
summary.outcome: Deployed the E57 additive calibration fix to `apply_mycelium_feedback` (changing SET to += semantics), validated it with 11 regression tests and 40,000+ autoresearch runs across E55-E64, derived and empirically confirmed the Mycelium convergence formula (`consensus_n = 0.85 − 0.125 × (1−lr/2)^n`), opened PR #113 with all session improvements, and added a retirement criterion to the autoresearch loop that prevents infinite re-confirmation of converged experiments.

repo: run_llm_deliberation() unconditionally overwrites _score_adjustments[vt] on every call (two-layer model: _mycelium_calibration is the stable accumulator, _score_adjustments is the per-deliberation read surface). Any code that modifies _score_adjustments directly is overwritten before the next deliberation.
SCHEDULE labels (e.g. 'E12_persist') must be normalized to match experiment name strings passed to log_result (e.g. 'E12') for the retirement criterion to fire correctly.

The Resource voice evaluator only checks budget_available context, not description text — it requires explicit keyword extension ('cost', 'budget', 'efficient') to be text-sensitive like the other voices.

ManifoldEnv's `_mycelium_calibration` path and `_score_adjustments` are separate abstractions that E47-style voice profile experiments must target correctly — modifying _score_adjustments has no effect when run_llm_deliberation will overwrite it.
Gemini worktrees (.gemini/worktrees/) are cleaned up automatically; any code written only there and not committed to the main repo will be permanently lost.
The Playwright pre-commit hook runs unconditionally (no `files:` filter) and requires a live Next.js server at localhost:3000, blocking all commits when the server is not running.

SurrealDB: `SELECT 1;` returns 400 (invalid SurrealQL); use `RETURN true;` for probing. All datetime fields require `time::now()` not string literals. SCHEMAFULL tables block arbitrary metadata subfields — store variable data in `option<string>` fields as JSON instead.

The quad-silver proposal formula (all four voice keywords: 'optimize/efficient' + 'architecture' + 'safety/align' + budget=True) produces 0.9325 heuristic consensus and 100% approval rate; this is the attractor state for heuristic mode.

JEPA learning requires distributional diversity — in heuristic mode all deliberations produce near-identical 12D state vectors, so the world model sees a single-attractor distribution and cannot generalize regardless of replay buffer size.
Floating-point: `sum([0.85]*n)/n < 0.85` in IEEE 754 — use `result.approved` (direct threshold comparison) not float mean comparison to test threshold crossing.

code.finding: apply_mycelium_feedback had SET semantics (_score_adjustments[vt] = adjustment) causing cycle 2 to decay as observed mean crept up. Fixed to additive: _mycelium_calibration[vt] += adjustment; _score_adjustments[vt] = _mycelium_calibration[vt]. Also added _evaluate_resource keyword check (+0.10 for 'cost'/'budget'/'efficient'/'resource'/'reduce' in description).

Was entirely simulated — connect() set self.connected=True with no real HTTP call. Full rewrite to use httpx POST to http://127.0.0.1:8001/sql with Basic root:root auth and surreal-ns/surreal-db headers. journey_point inserts require metadata={} and time::now() for datetime; EVO biography goes into result field (option<string>) as compact JSON.

_score_adjustments and _mycelium_calibration must both be initialized in __init__ as dict.fromkeys(VoiceType, 0.0). Dynamic creation causes failures when E47-style profile experiments back up and restore calibration state.

Voice scores map to 12D action as: Architect→dims 0-2, Engineer→dims 4,5,8, Ethicist→dim 9, Resource→dim 11. Verifiable reward: 0.4*r_hiho + 0.2*r_conservation + 0.2*r_unitarity + 0.2*r_gauge. r_hiho = 1 - 4*var(position) peaks at 1.0 when all dims=0.5.

_check_retirement uses CV of last 10 keep metrics < 0.05 AND n_keeps >= 20 to retire converged experiments. Also fires for 0-keep experiments after min_runs=20 with 0% keep_frac. Label normalization required: strip suffixes (_lite, _xl, _persist, etc.) to match JSONL experiment keys.

11 regression tests guard E57 fix. Synthesized skill format must use 'architect: mean_score=X.XXXX' pattern (output of _synthesize_evo_deliberation_skill), NOT 'voice_scores=[...]' format (input to ingest_evo_journeys).

workflow: timeit.default_timer() is the correct instrument for experiment wall-clock timing — monotonic, sub-microsecond, unaffected by NTP corrections during long runs.

Autodata analysis of keep/discard rates reveals bimodal signal: experiments settle into either 0% keep (ceiling/saturation) or 100% keep (genuine signal). This bimodality is the correct target state — the retirement criterion should fire at both extremes.

Pre-specifying experiment metric and falsification criterion before implementation would have prevented 3 experiment redesigns (E50, E54, E60) where the initial metric was unachievable or measured the wrong thing.
Running multiple simultaneous loop processes (stale + new) causes silent event-stealing from queues. Always kill old processes explicitly before starting new ones.
ruff format runs as a pre-commit hook and reformats files, requiring git add after formatting and before commit — always format first, then stage, then commit.
When a PR branch is 200+ commits behind target, squash-cherry-pick of unique file changes is safer than interactive rebase replay through all conflicts.
Saving experiment findings to vault during the session (not just at the end) preserves them across context compaction events.

friction: Gemini worktree (.gemini/worktrees/) was silently cleaned up mid-session, permanently losing the 3500-line overnight_evo_loop.py with E55-E62 experiments, retirement criterion, shared Mycelium registry, and SurrealDB persistence — requiring full reconstruction from memory.
pyproject.toml merge conflicts between HEAD and isolated/session-oom-modularity blocked uv run until manually resolved.
Playwright pre-commit hook (no files: filter, no server running) blocked every commit requiring repeated workarounds.
ruff format hook required format-then-stage-then-commit dance on every commit; linter also silently overwrote Edit tool changes, requiring re-application.
Multiple stale overnight loop processes accumulated over the session (6+ PIDs at one point), silently stealing telemetry events from each other's queues.

SurrealDB schema caused repeated INSERT failures: SCHEMAFULL rejection of metadata subfields, datetime string format rejection (needed time::now()), missing required fields (transaction_time, agent_name) not documented anywhere.
Lemonade iGPU ROCm entered silent failure state (all evaluation prompts return empty string while arithmetic works), making LLM mode unreliable for extended runs.
An interactive rebase from a concurrent autoresearch process left the repo in REBASE_HEAD detached state, blocking branch switching.
The TelemetryBus + JourneyWorker pattern requires both bus.start() AND worker.start() — missing either causes silent event queue accumulation with no error.

The E46/E47 experiments needed 3+ redesigns each because initial metrics were unachievable (E47 consensus saturation due to _mycelium_calibration ceiling; E46 JEPA never trained because it was passing action as observed_next).
open_items: apply_mycelium_feedback has zero callers in src/ — the E57 production fix is deployed but dormant; needs wiring into CompoundExecutor or the orchestration layer to actually run in production.

Ouroboros fires 320+ HIHO drift warnings on experimental EVO lifecycle transitions (phase resets), wasting healing budget on non-production data — needs a flag to distinguish experimental from production EVOs.
Mycelium synthesized skills are local per-experiment instances and don't persist across runs or into the production MyceliumRegistry.
SurrealDB experiment_runs table has 0 records — the HTTP-direct write code was implemented but only in the Gemini worktree that was cleaned up.
E55-E62 experiments bypass the TelemetryBus (direct nexus.deliberate() calls), so 41,000+ autoresearch runs are in autoresearch.jsonl but NOT in SurrealDB journey_point.
E64 multi-cycle compounding was designed and committed but not yet confirmed experimentally — predicted to show monotonic crossing of 0.85 at cycle 4 with lr=1.0.
JEPA world model learning is bounded by heuristic mode's flat input distribution — E46 will remain at ~0.97-1.00 final_loss until LLM mode is reliable; requires iGPU ROCm recovery.
Retirement criterion needs cross-session persistence — currently in-memory only, resets on restart. Should seed from autoresearch.jsonl on startup.
PR branch autoresearch/pr-merge-20260502 is 210 commits behind main — the sigma-lint-bulk (#85) and other blocked PRs were deferred due to conflict risk.
The findings doc (docs/evo_autoresearch_findings.md) has a race condition with branch checkouts — it gets reverted when switching branches during the session.
